shell: shared/navigation.json#/shells/coursePlayerShell (minimal chrome, Sidebar collapsed on Web, same as Course Player)

layout.structure: single-column at every breakpoint — question-progress indicator -> QuestionCard -> answer options -> Next/Submit

noIntroScreen: no quiz-intro screen in MVP — first question renders immediately, question-progress indicator itself is sufficient framing
noPreviousControl: no skip, no back-to-previous-question control in MVP — deliberately linear/simple; already-selected answers ARE preserved if the student navigates away and returns

states.loading: question content skeleton if fetched per-question (unlikely necessary)
states.error: ErrorState if quiz fails to load

rtlBehavior: answer option text start-aligned; selection/correct/incorrect icons stay leading the text regardless of direction, mirrored per logical properties
responsiveRules: single-column at every breakpoint; Next/Submit pinned to bottom of viewport for thumb reach on Mobile
knownGaps: No showcase mockup exists — judged against design-system/COMPONENTS.md § Quiz System only.
